verses.pali: … Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye ariyena paññācakkhunā samannāgatā;
verses.english: … so too the sentient beings who have the noble eye of wisdom are few,

verses.pali: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye avijjāgatā sammūḷhā.
verses.english: while those who are ignorant and confused are many.
